observations: Two photos show the same used internal combustion engine removed from a vehicle and sitting on a concrete floor.
Other engines and a gearbox are visible in the background and foreground.
Visible parts include valve cover, intake manifold, alternator, belts, hoses, wiring, and engine mounts.
A metal identification plate is stamped to the engine block but the text is not legible in either photo.
No brand name, logo, or model number is clearly readable on the engine itself.
Watermark 'UDEMEX LIMITED POSTED ON JIJI' appears across both images.

claims.evidence: Not readable in photos; seller text only.
Cannot confirm import status from photos or remotely.
Photos show a used engine but no test of operation.
Engine is out of the vehicle; no running or cranking video provided.

response.reason: The engine brand and model cannot be read from the photos, and the seller's text lists multiple Toyota models with different values, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without the identification plate.
